frozen_calculus.name: SKOLEM_LOCAL_DERIVATION_V1_1_SHIELDING_BRIDGE
allowed_rule_forms: GUARDED_ITE(guard, rule_true, rule_false) with hash-consed sharing
frozen_calculus.leaf_discharge: INTERNAL_COVER_WITNESS(alpha) checked clausewise on the residual CNF

search_relation.boundary_variables: one Boolean y_e for each edge e in E
search_relation.internal_witness_variables: selector bits s_v, one for each vertex v in V
search_relation.charge_vector: c_0=1 and c_v=0 for v>0; total charge is odd
search_relation.vertex_violation: viol_v(Y) := XOR_{e incident to v} y_e != c_v
search_relation.domain: D_G(Y)=TRUE for every Y because an odd total charge makes simultaneous satisfaction of all vertex parity equations impossible
search_relation.witness_semantics: Any nonempty subset of violated vertices is admissible; the frozen constructor may synthesize one-hot witnesses only.

cnf_encoding.per_vertex_implication: For every local incident-edge pattern whose parity equals c_v, add one clause forbidding s_v=1 together with that nonviolating pattern.

source_generation.stub_ordering: Sort the 3n labelled stubs by SHA256(SALT|n|nonce|vertex|stub_index), pair adjacent stubs, reject loops, parallel edges, wrong degree, or disconnected graphs.
source_generation.nonce_rule: Choose the least nonnegative nonce whose graph passes every frozen source gate.
source_generation.expansion_check: Exact exhaustive subset check is permitted only in source-fixture generation for these finite n values. It is forbidden in blind synthesis and independent proof verification.

blind_surface.boundary_order: Sort boundary variables by SHA256(BOUNDARY_ORDER_SALT|input_digest|var_id); freeze in the input authority before constructor code is executed.

frozen_constructor.name: GENERIC_CLAUSEWISE_SHANNON_INTERNAL_COVER_SYNTHESIS_V1
algorithm: Canonicalize the residual CNF under the current partial boundary assignment.
Probe only the preregistered polynomial candidate set of internal assignments: all-zero plus every one-hot assignment over internal witness bits.
Accept a leaf only if INTERNAL_COVER_WITNESS(alpha) passes by clausewise residual checking; no SAT or generic validity call is allowed.
Otherwise branch on the next still-relevant variable in the frozen boundary order.
Construct exact complementary 0/1 children, memoize by (boundary-order position, canonical residual CNF), and hash-cons all witness GUARDED_ITE nodes.
For each internal witness bit, build its shared Skolem DAG from leaf constants and complementary boundary-literal GUARDED_ITE nodes.
frozen_constructor.candidate_set_size_per_state: |V|+1, hence polynomial in the frozen input
frozen_constructor.hash_consing: required for residual states and proof nodes

verification: Recompute the root normalized CNF from the frozen input.
For every branch state, independently recompute both residual children by assigning the declared boundary literal 0 and 1.
Require the declared guard to equal the next allowed frozen boundary variable and require exact complementary coverage by construction.
For every leaf, independently run only the clausewise INTERNAL_COVER_WITNESS(alpha) checker on the residual CNF.
Recompute each witness-bit CONST/GUARDED_ITE proof node from already verified child roots and hash-consing identities.
Require the root witness vector to be attached to the root residual state.

resource_envelope.envelope_role: Preregistered finite diagnostic envelope only; crossing it is an observed constructor blowup, not a lower bound on all proof DAGs.

verdict_rules.PASS_SCOPED_HOSTILE_SYNTHESIS: Every frozen finite specimen is independently accepted with exact total domain, witness proof, clean forbidden-machinery audit, and no preregistered observation-envelope breach.
verdict_rules.FAIL_CALCULUS_EXPRESSIVITY: A separately frozen admissible compact certificate exists but the frozen V1.1 rule forms cannot certify it. This label requires an independently preregistered witness-injection control and may not be inferred from blind failure alone.
verdict_rules.FAIL_SYNTHESIS_ACCESS: After candidate freeze, a compact certificate accepted by the same frozen verifier is supplied independently, while the blind constructor failed to synthesize one without forbidden machinery.
verdict_rules.FAIL_PROOF_DAG_BLOWUP: The frozen constructor crosses the preregistered residual-state or proof-node observation envelope. This is only an observed constructor outcome and is not a mathematical proof that polynomial proof DAGs do not exist.
verdict_rules.FAIL_HIDDEN_GENERIC_VALIDATION: Audit finds SAT, generic validity, generic tautology, source/reference import, semantic truth-table use, or a special Tseitin/expander recognizer in the blind path.
verdict_rules.FAIL_DOMAIN_DROPPED: The candidate omits exact total-domain coverage or leaves a boundary branch uncovered.
verdict_rules.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Frozen wallclock or memory budget is exhausted before a stronger preregistered classification is reached.
